pli-tv-bi-vb-pc44:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc44:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo gihiveyyāvaccaṃ karonti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc44:1.3: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc44:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo gihiveyyāvaccaṃ karissantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc44:1.5: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo gihiveyyāvaccaṃ karontīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc44:1.8: hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo gihiveyyāvaccaṃ karissanti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc44:1.10: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc44:1.11.1: yā pana bhikkhunī gihiveyyāvaccaṃ kareyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc44:2.1.6: āgārikassa yāguṃ vā bhattaṃ vā khādanīyaṃ vā pacati sāṭakaṃ vā veṭhanaṃ vā dhovati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc44:2.2.5: attano veyyāvaccakarassa yāguṃ vā bhattaṃ vā khādanīyaṃ vā pacati sāṭakaṃ vā veṭhanaṃ vā dhovati
